shelters.name: Humane Colorado (Denver Dumb Friends League)
shelters.description: Established in 1910, the largest independent nonprofit community-based animal shelter in the Rocky Mountain region. Rebranded from Dumb Friends League to Humane Colorado in 2025.

shelters.name: Humane Society of the Pikes Peak Region
shelters.description: Founded in 1949, the largest animal welfare group for homeless and abused animals in Southern Colorado. BBB-accredited charity with 4/4 stars from Charity Navigator.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Boulder Valley
shelters.description: Since 1902, providing shelter and care to over 16,000 animals yearly with 92% adoption/reunification rate. Operates adoption center, veterinary hospital, and training center.

shelters.name: NOCO Humane
shelters.description: Founded in 1969 as Larimer Humane Society, northern Colorado's largest animal welfare organization. Provides full-service animal control for Fort Collins, Loveland, and Larimer County.

shelters.name: Foothills Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Jefferson County's only open-admission shelter and Colorado's largest single-campus animal agency. Shelters 8,500+ pets and provides resources for 6,000+ community animals yearly.

shelters.name: MaxFund Animal Adoption Center
shelters.description: Denver's true no-kill shelter established in 1988, providing medical care for injured pets with no known owners. Leading the no-kill movement in Colorado.

shelters.name: Longmont Humane Society
shelters.description: Nonprofit organization serving the Longmont area with animal shelter and adoption services.

shelters.name: Animal Friends Alliance
shelters.description: Saving animals in Northern Colorado since 2006. Adoption-guarantee shelter with subsidized spay/neuter clinic and resources to keep pets in loving homes.

shelters.name: Cat Care Society
shelters.description: Shelters cats in cage-free environments until adopted, operates cat clinic onsite, and provides community programs including food bank for low-income pet owners.

shelters.name: Aurora Animal Shelter
shelters.description: City of Aurora municipal animal shelter providing animal control and adoption services. New state-of-the-art facility anticipated to open in 2028.

shelters.name: HSSPV - Humane Society of the South Platte Valley
shelters.description: Non-profit animal shelter serving Cherry Hills Village, Columbine Valley, Englewood, and Littleton in the south Denver metro area.

shelters.name: National Mill Dog Rescue
shelters.description: Mission to rescue, rehabilitate, and rehome discarded breeding dogs and educate the public about commercial dog breeding.

shelters.name: Animal Rescue of the Rockies
shelters.description: Foster-based animal rescue pulling homeless dogs and cats from overcrowded shelters and placing them in foster homes until forever homes are found.

shelters.name: L.O.L.A.'s Rescue
shelters.description: Volunteer non-profit focusing on animals from high-kill shelters and at-risk animals in abuse, neglect, and abandonment situations.

shelters.name: Routt County Humane Society
shelters.description: Serving Routt County with animal shelter and adoption services in the Steamboat Springs area.

shelters.name: Colorado Pet Pantry
shelters.description: Temporarily feeds Colorado pets, helping families care for pets with the goal of keeping them out of shelters.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Weld County
shelters.description: Serving Weld County with animal shelter, adoption services, and community programs.

shelters.name: Denver Animal Shelter
shelters.description: City and County of Denver municipal animal shelter providing animal control and adoption services.

shelters.name: Colorado Humane Society
shelters.description: Statewide humane society serving multiple counties across Colorado with animal welfare services.

shelters.name: Angels with Paws
shelters.description: Cat rescue organization serving the Denver metro area with adoption services.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Aurora
shelters.description: 501(c)3 charitable organization assisting regional animal rescues and providing resources for pet owners in need.

shelters.name: Buddy Center - Humane Colorado
shelters.description: Humane Colorado satellite location serving Douglas County with animal adoption services.

shelters.name: Colorado Reptile Humane Society
shelters.description: Improves the lives of reptiles through education, sheltering, conservation, and rehabilitation programs.

shelters.name: Pueblo Animal Services
shelters.description: City of Pueblo municipal animal services providing animal control and shelter services.

shelters.name: No Kill Colorado
shelters.description: Nonprofit dedicated to ensuring every healthy and treatable animal has a chance to live, working with shelters, rescues, and lawmakers to end unnecessary euthanasia.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Colorado animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Humane Colorado (formerly Denver Dumb Friends League, founded 1910) is the largest independent shelter in the Rocky Mountain region. Coverage spans Denver metro, Colorado Springs, Boulder, Fort Collins, and mountain communities.
